text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
asag and sitio Volcan within the jurisdiction of Man-
bajao, Province of Misamis Oriental, on condition that
all the unpaid taxes and penalties corresponding to 1951
and previous years and the remaining 50 per cent of the
1952 taxes shall be paid on or before December 31, 1952.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philizpines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
